title: Machine-Learning-Guided Peptide Drug Discovery: Development of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists with Improved Drug Properties
summary: A machine-learning-guided peptide optimization workflow selected GUB021794, reported at 0.018 nM GLP-1R potency in the paper assay and dose-dependent weight loss in diet-induced obese mice. These preclinical results do not establish human efficacy, safety or a dosing regimen.
ai_technology: streaMLine machine-learning QSAR analysis integrated with peptide synthesis and screening

evidence.tested: Primary abstract reports the named candidate and mouse outcomes; no human clinical result is established.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and exhaustive prior-art review are not established.
evidence.ai_role: streaMLine machine-learning QSAR analysis integrated with peptide synthesis and screening

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for study identity, AI operation, dates, affiliations and the bounded result. PubMed affiliation block names Gubra.
